## Type of change

- [ ] feat — new capability
- [ ] fix — defect fix
- [ ] docs — documentation
- [ ] refactor — behaviour-preserving restructure
- [ ] perf — performance
- [ ] test — test only
- [ ] chore — build, dependency, tooling

## How verified

- [ ] `npm run lint`
- [ ] `npm run type:check`
- [ ] `npm test`
- [ ] `npm run build`
- [ ] `npm run smoke:all` (when server or data model changed)
- [ ] `npm run qa:journey` (when routes or UI changed)
- [ ] Screenshots attached (UI change)
